text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of the spring Tenno Sho is<n>here. Have we
found a way to<n>compete against Tamamo Cross's
purpose of racing for her<n>less-than-fortunate
family?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well? Did ya find a reason to race<n>that's better
than mine?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thought so. Not that easy to find your<n>own reason,
yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Happy, satisfied folks should just sit<n>quietly and
enjoy their lives.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Creek, today's crown is mine for the<n>takin'! I'm
the star!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And I'll whomp that trainer lurkin'<n>behind ya so
bad they'll never be the<n>same.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Eh?! Wh-what's gotten into ya all of<n>a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but I can't let you do that,<n>Tamtam.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's the one thing you won't ever<n>get away
with!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The hell? I've never seen you like<n>this before...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, no point tryin' to threaten me<n>though. Sheer
will's not gonna win<n>you the race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Cause I ain't gonna hold back!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's a terrifyingly serious look on<n>Super
Creek's face.
